en.t: "The day after tomorrow would be all right, wouldn't it?" I asked, pressing him once more.

units.source_text: 但我没说要同名人商量，就向大竹告辞了。

en.t: But without saying that I would consult the Master, I took my leave of Otake.

units.source_text: 七段向我翻来覆去地说要放弃比赛。

en.t: The seventh dan kept telling me again and again that he would forfeit the match.
